outcomes.name: home names the shop admin and offers Orders
outcomes.expect: Ticket criterion 1: The home page (`/`) shows the heading "Shop admin" and a link "Orders"

outcomes.name: the Orders link opens the orders page
outcomes.expect: Ticket criterion 1: a link "Orders" that opens `/orders`

outcomes.name: orders page lists every order in id order
outcomes.expect: Ticket criterion 2: `/orders` shows the heading "Orders", a search box labelled "Search by customer", and one row per order in the id order above. A row shows customer, item and total with a dollar sign, e.g. "Alice Nguyen Standing desk $480".

outcomes.name: orders page shows Loading orders and a disabled box while loading, then neither
outcomes.expect: Ticket criterion 3: While orders are loading, the page shows "Loading orders" and the search box is disabled. When loading finishes the message is gone and the box can be typed in.

outcomes.name: typing part of a customer name narrows the list
outcomes.expect: Ticket criterion 4: Typing narrows the list to orders whose customer name contains the text.

outcomes.name: search ignores case and surrounding spaces
outcomes.expect: Ticket criterion 4: Case and surrounding spaces do not matter: "ali" and " ALICE " both leave only Alice Nguyen's two orders.

outcomes.name: search looks at customer names only
outcomes.expect: Ticket criterion 5: Search looks at customer names only: "desk", an item word, shows no orders.

outcomes.name: no match shows No orders match and what was typed
outcomes.expect: Ticket criterion 6: When nothing matches, no rows are shown and the page says "No orders match" followed by what was typed, e.g. "No orders match zed".

outcomes.name: clearing the box brings back all five orders and hides the message
outcomes.expect: Ticket criterion 7: Clearing the box brings back all five orders and hides that message.
